```markdown
## Context

Reviewers sometimes need a local copy of the report they are viewing.

## Problem

Reviewers ask for a download of the report that keeps every row, so their local copy matches what they were viewing. A download that drops rows would leave them with an incomplete copy.

A report with two rows should download as a file containing those same two rows.

## Idea

reporter proposes a download action; src/report-download.ts:12 routes this through downloadReport

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Given a report containing two rows, when a reviewer downloads it, the downloaded file contains those same two rows.
```
